verdict.rationale: Google Cloud's Knowledge Catalog (formerly Dataplex) documents data lineage that tracks where data originates, how it transforms, and where it moves across systems including BigQuery. That covers the 'where data came from' half of the story at a general level, though through a companion catalog service rather than BigQuery itself. The pack has no evidence of audit logs showing who ran which query, and nothing shows the lineage works at column granularity. Missing for 10: audit logs of who ran what (user/query attribution), column-level lineage specifically, lineage delivered by BigQuery itself, independent or hands-on corroboration.
